description: Append-only record of one rate resolution: which Rate Card version priced one timesheet line, and the day rate + day-rate basis that were applied. Snapshotting the basis (not just the day rate) lets the reconciliation engine compare the BASIS across the billable and payable sides. Immutable - a closed period reprices identically; a correction is a new resolution, never an edit.

fields.description: The Rate Card that priced this line.
fields.label: Resolved Card

fields.description: Version of the card in force at the period cutoff, snapshotted so a closed period reprices identically.
fields.label: Resolved Version

fields.description: The billing period this resolution priced.
fields.label: Timesheet Period

fields.description: The specific timesheet line that was priced.
fields.label: Timesheet Line

fields.description: Denormalized snapshot of the card billing unit at resolution time.
fields.label: Billing Unit

fields.description: The day rate actually used. Computed at runtime from the seeded card value - not a committed configuration value.
fields.label: Day Rate Applied

fields.description: The day-rate basis actually used (C3 snapshot). The reconciliation engine compares THIS across the billable and payable sides so a basis mismatch is caught, not just a day-count difference.
fields.label: Day Rate Basis Applied
